n0ec87c3bd2c.s: What is the installed hydel capacity of the Polavaram Project?
n0ec87c3bd2c.x: The Polavaram hydel component has an installed capacity of 960 MW, made up of 12 units of 80 MW each.

n8515ab1e556.s: How much Godavari water does the Polavaram Right Main Canal transfer to the Krishna?
n8515ab1e556.x: Polavaram transfers 80 TMC of Godavari water to the Krishna through the Right Main Canal; 23.44 TMC is provided for Visakhapatnam.

nfc38d492dbb.s: The Polavaram Project site, earlier identified with West Godavari district, now lies in which district?
nfc38d492dbb.x: The project is near Polavaram village in Eluru district; the site was earlier identified with West Godavari district.

n052a5c67811.s: The Left Main Canal of the Polavaram Project carries water to:
n052a5c67811.x: The Left Main Canal carries water to Visakhapatnam, while the Right Main Canal feeds the Krishna delta.

nc0f84212ae5.s: The Polavaram Ordinance, 2014 kept the submergence-area villages and mandals of which district with Andhra Pradesh?
nc0f84212ae5.x: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014 amended the territorial provision so that Khammam villages and mandals in the Polavaram submergence area remained with Andhra Pradesh.

n5455c5f6d49.s: In February 2026, how much did Andhra Pradesh seek from the Centre for Polavaram Phase-II?
n5455c5f6d49.x: On 11 Feb 2026 AP sought Rs 32,000 crore for Polavaram Phase-II along with permanent lifting of the MoEF stop-work order; Rs 55,548 crore is the older RCE and Rs 3,320 crore the 2026-27 Budget allocation.

nc288b9a7570.s: Which of the following Polavaram issues remains unresolved?
o: Clearance of the revised cost estimate
Constitution of the Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal
nc288b9a7570.x: The revised cost estimate of the Polavaram Project had not yet been cleared; the other items are not pending.

n1ed0d9c3c64.s: The Telugu Ganga project mainly supplies drinking water to which city?
n1ed0d9c3c64.x: Telugu Ganga carries Krishna surplus through the Srisailam-Somasila-Kandaleru-Poondi system to supply drinking water to Chennai and irrigate parts of Rayalaseema and Nellore.

n80c0660581a.s: The intended command area of the Galeru-Nagari Sujala Sravanthi project is:
n80c0660581a.x: Galeru-Nagari (38 TMC) has an intended command area of 2.60 lakh acres covering Kadapa, Annamayya, Tirupati, Chittoor and Nellore.

n5a2c13b8c24.s: Which project is listed in the Eleventh Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 for completion with existing water sharing?
n5a2c13b8c24.x: The Eleventh Schedule lists Handri-Neeva, Telugu Ganga, Galeru-Nagari, Veligonda, Kalwakurthy and Nettempadu for completion with the existing water-sharing arrangements.

n9e30d31235b.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Prakasam Barrage – Multipurpose dam on the Godavari
Nagarjuna Sagar – Temporary lift scheme until Polavaram is completed
Galeru-Nagari – Supplies Godavari water to the Krishna delta
n9e30d31235b.x: Polavaram is a National Project with irrigation, drinking-water, hydropower and flood-control objectives; the other pairs confuse functions or river systems.

ncb14d215c4e.s: The Veligonda project draws Krishna water by gravity through Nallamala tunnels from which reservoir?
ncb14d215c4e.x: Veligonda takes Krishna water from Srisailam by gravity through tunnels in the Nallamala range into Nallamala Sagar.

n2b0ac876f25.s: Which of the following pairs (project – Plan period) is correctly matched?
n2b0ac876f25.x: Srisailam was sanctioned in 1963, in the Third Plan. Prakasam Barrage belongs to the First-Second Plan, Telugu Ganga (1983) to the Sixth Plan and Jalayagnam (2004) to the Tenth Plan.

n8fdc681cf6f.s: Under APFAMGS, farmers prepare crop-water budgets and voluntarily regulate:
n8fdc681cf6f.x: APFAMGS promotes farmer-led collection of rainfall and well-level data, crop-water budgeting and voluntary regulation of pumping.

n0c6e409dbef.s: The Pattiseema lift scheme lifts Godavari water into which canal to carry it to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage?
n0c6e409dbef.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal, which carries it to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage - the first Godavari-Krishna link.

neb59cd708f6.s: Which source had the largest share (47.3%) of India's net irrigated area in 2021-22?
neb59cd708f6.x: Tube wells accounted for 47.3% of India's net irrigated area in 2021-22, followed by canals at 24.7%.

n371ecb22a7d.s: The foundation stone of the Veligonda project was laid on:
n371ecb22a7d.x: N. Chandrababu Naidu laid the foundation stone of the Veligonda project on 5 March 1996.

n17b690d9e2a.s: APWALTA, 2002 requires rainwater-harvesting structures on premises measuring at least:
n17b690d9e2a.x: APWALTA, 2002 requires rainwater-harvesting structures on residential, commercial and other premises of 200 sq m or more.

n14adf2d08f3.s: The ₹10,000 crore Micro Irrigation Fund, which funds Andhra Pradesh among eight States, is maintained through:
n14adf2d08f3.x: The Micro Irrigation Fund has a ₹10,000 crore corpus maintained through NABARD, and AP is among the eight States funded.

nfe53d697da6.s: The National Hydrology Project helped Andhra Pradesh establish:
nfe53d697da6.x: The National Hydrology Project set up Andhra Pradesh's real-time groundwater monitoring system.

nap-geography-22-2.s: Which of the following about tanks in Andhra Pradesh is NOT correct?
o: Coastal Andhra has more than 14,000 minor tanks
Rayalaseema's tanks support irrigation and groundwater recharge
Coastal Andhra has over 6,800 active tanks mainly for recharge
Rayalaseema has more than 6,800 active tanks
nap-geography-22-2.x: The over 6,800 active tanks for irrigation and recharge belong to Rayalaseema, not Coastal Andhra, which has over 14,000 minor tanks.

n44f7b47c748.s: Hirakud dam in Odisha is notable as:
o: The largest concrete arch dam in Asia
The highest gravity dam in India
The first tidal barrage in India
One of the longest earthen dams
n44f7b47c748.x: Hirakud in Odisha is noted as one of the longest earthen dams.

ne83f4916c53.s: After remeasurement, the coastline of Andhra Pradesh is reported as about:
ne83f4916c53.x: The older figure was 974 km; remeasurement gave 1,053 km, supporting the State's port-led EXIM strategy.

n87f1cd505da.s: After bifurcation, residual Andhra Pradesh got about 58% of the population and debt but only about ____ of the revenue.
n87f1cd505da.x: AP received about 58% of the population and debt but only around 46% of the revenue, reflecting the loss of Hyderabad's revenue base.

n4a7effaff1d.s: Which company's unit near Tirupati is part of rebuilding Rayalaseema as an industrial hub?
n4a7effaff1d.x: Rayalaseema's industrial-hub development is associated with Kia, JSW, Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the Space City.

nadaae376b18.s: The Andhra Pradesh Maritime Policy 2024–29 aims to make the State India's leading:
nadaae376b18.x: The AP Maritime Policy 2024–29 aims to make Andhra Pradesh India's leading maritime gateway.

nindian-economy-68-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Industrial Corridor – Movement of goods, services and economic activity
NIMZ – Industrial development along with connectivity
Dedicated Freight Corridor – Dedicated railway freight infrastructure
Economic Corridor – Large areas with a world-class manufacturing ecosystem
nindian-economy-68-11.x: A Dedicated Freight Corridor is dedicated railway freight infrastructure. An industrial corridor combines industry with connectivity, an economic corridor moves goods and services, and an NIMZ is a large manufacturing area.

nd50b3641e78.x: Bhogapuram airport became operational on 1 August 2026; 1 June 2026 is when the SCoR zone became operational.

n137bb84c873.s: Which of the following was NOT one of the four DISCOMs formed in the 2000 unbundling?
n137bb84c873.x: The 2000 arrangement had EPDCL-Visakhapatnam, CPDCL-Hyderabad, NPDCL-Warangal and SPDCL-Tirupati; the Vijayawada-based APCPDCL was formed later.

ne8fd076c840.s: Which scheme, introduced in 2021, replaced UDAY in power distribution reform?
ne8fd076c840.x: The Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), introduced in 2021, replaced UDAY (2015).

n349b07e237b.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 proposed how many regional medical hubs for medical tourism?
n349b07e237b.x: The Union Budget 2026–27 proposed five regional medical hubs for medical tourism, along with five university townships in industrial corridors.

nc356bbfd909.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: OSAT – Offshore Semiconductor Assembly and Testing
LIFT – Land Incentive for Tech Hubs
nc356bbfd909.x: LIFT stands for Land Incentive for Tech Hubs; GCC is Global Capability Centre, RTIH is Ratan Tata Innovation Hub and OSAT is Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test.

naa99f77c921.s: AP State FiberNet Ltd. is notable as India's first:
naa99f77c921.x: APSFL is India's first State-owned ISP and also functions as a telecom and IPTV provider.

n17b63d044df.s: The Network Operations Centre of AP Fiber Grid Phase-I is located at:
n17b63d044df.x: Phase-I comprises 24,000 km of fibre on an IP-MPLS ring with its Network Operations Centre at Visakhapatnam.

n449107e7696.s: The State Data Lake at the AP State Data Centre is a single source of truth for more than how many departments?
n449107e7696.x: The State Data Lake serves as a single source of truth for more than 40 departments and about 400 applications.

ne3af8adfff2.s: Before bifurcation in 2014, the IT exports of Andhra Pradesh came mainly from:
ne3af8adfff2.x: Before bifurcation, Hyderabad's HITEC City and Cyberabad, developed under N. Chandrababu Naidu, generated the State's IT exports.

n378d968f5c0.s: After 2014, Andhra Pradesh rebuilt its IT base mainly around which city?
n378d968f5c0.x: N. Chandrababu Naidu's 1990s IT push built HITEC City; after 2014 AP rebuilt its IT base around Visakhapatnam.

n2fc373112ee.s: Besides other Indian States, the APCNF model is being replicated in:
n2fc373112ee.x: The APCNF model is being replicated in other Indian States as well as in Zambia and Sri Lanka.

n70d608a00e9.s: In which year did the AP Community-Managed Natural Farming programme receive the Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity?
n70d608a00e9.x: APCNF received the (shared) Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity in 2024, announced in Lisbon on 11 July 2024.

n84b6db6aad1.s: The National Animal Disease Control Programme, launched in September 2019 to eradicate FMD by 2030, is funded:
n84b6db6aad1.x: NADCP is 100% centrally funded, was launched in September 2019 and aims to eradicate foot-and-mouth disease by 2030.

n1867b625d82.s: In GAP Polambadi, the term 'Polambadi' means:
n1867b625d82.x: Polambadi means Farmer Field Schools; GAP Polambadi teaches Good Agricultural Practices and is linked to Ind.GAP certification.

nf09bce18c90.s: APCNF targets coverage of how many farmers by 2028–29?
nf09bce18c90.x: APCNF covers 10.20 lakh farmers over 4.89 lakh hectares and targets 41 lakh farmers over 19 lakh hectares by 2028–29.

n9d178d81bab.s: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) promotes organic farming in clusters certified under:
n9d178d81bab.x: PKVY is the organic farming scheme with clusters of 50 farmers / 50 acres certified under PGS-India.

nafbd8012f76.s: By how much did the food-grain area of Andhra Pradesh increase in 2024-25?
nafbd8012f76.x: The food-grain area rose by 12.85% in 2024-25, following an 11.7% rainfall surplus; 16.5% was the previous year's rainfall deficit.

nfc975a51340.s: In December 2019, Kakinada farmers were advised to stop growing Bondalu paddy because its earlier buyer State began growing it. Which State?
nfc975a51340.x: Kerala, the earlier buyer of Bondalu rice from AP, had started producing it itself.

n45decdd2f67.s: Which region is Andhra Pradesh's main rice-growing area and aquaculture hub?
n45decdd2f67.x: The Godavari delta, covering East and West Godavari, is the main rice-growing area and an aquaculture hub.

naa1a35601cc.s: The cropping pattern of Andhra Pradesh is currently shifting mainly towards:
naa1a35601cc.x: The shift is towards fruits, vegetables, flowers and spices because of their profitability and export potential.

n74bdbecc72d.s: e-Crop booking at Rythu Seva Kendras is a:
n74bdbecc72d.x: e-Crop booking creates a digital crop record used as the basis for insurance, MSP procurement, input subsidy and loss assessment.

n5f6add82473.s: What is Andhra Pradesh's rank in coffee production in India?
n5f6add82473.x: Andhra Pradesh ranks fourth in coffee production, and 100% of its coffee comes from Araku Valley.

nfcd1a380ac5.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with Andhra Pradesh's national rank?
nfcd1a380ac5.x: AP ranked fourth (11.37 lakh tonnes) in meat, not first; it ranks first in eggs (2,739 crore) and seventh in milk.

nfe5ef4c1d99.s: Andhra Pradesh's position in India's cultured-shrimp production is:
nfe5ef4c1d99.x: Andhra Pradesh is India's largest shrimp producer, accounting for about 75% of India's cultured-shrimp exports (2025-26).

nf93220c7f2d.s: Under YSR Rythu Bharosa-PM Kisan (2019–2024), annual assistance per farmer family was:
nf93220c7f2d.x: YSR Rythu Bharosa-PM Kisan gave ₹13,500 per family per year, covering owners, tenant farmers and RoFR cultivators.

n87e580b130e.s: The annual assistance per farmer family under Annadata Sukhibhava-PM Kisan is:
n87e580b130e.x: It provides ₹20,000 per farmer family a year: ₹14,000 from the State and ₹6,000 under PM-KISAN from the Centre.

n28e2ccd2b51.s: Which scheme in Andhra Pradesh is associated with sheep and goat units?
n28e2ccd2b51.x: Jeeva Kranthi provides sheep and goat units, whereas Paala Velluva concerns dairy units for women.

nb917cb2a74d.s: Under MIDH, the Centre–State funding ratio for general States is:
nb917cb2a74d.x: MIDH is funded 60:40 in general States, 90:10 in North-Eastern and Himalayan States, and 100% centrally for NHB, CDB and CIH.

nf9f272fa561.s: Andhra Pradesh targets micro-irrigation coverage of what share of its GSA by 2030?
nf9f272fa561.x: The targets are 35% of GSA by 2030, 50% by 2047, and 15 lakh hectares within five years.

n10c93ef7a88.s: Under Paala Velluva, milk from women's dairy units is procured by:
n10c93ef7a88.x: Paala Velluva provides dairy units for women, with Amul procuring the milk.

nce40b422c0c.s: APSADA licenses freshwater aquaculture in Andhra Pradesh through:
nce40b422c0c.x: APSADA licenses freshwater aquaculture through the e-Matsyakar system.

na9d00bcb70f.s: Coastal aquaculture farms within 2 km of the High Tide Line are regulated by the:
na9d00bcb70f.x: Farms within 2 km of the HTL are regulated by the Coastal Aquaculture Authority under the CAA Act, 2005.

n751f470253c.s: The aqua-power tariff for farms up to 10 acres inside notified aqua zones in Andhra Pradesh is:
n751f470253c.x: The tariff is ₹1.50 per unit for farms up to 10 acres inside notified aqua zones and ₹3.85 per unit for bigger farms or farms outside them.

n4e19f62a516.s: Andhra Pradesh accounts for about what share of India's cultured-shrimp exports?
n4e19f62a516.x: The later figures put AP at 75% of India's cultured-shrimp exports and 31% of India's shrimp exports.

ne6d07df3069.s: Andhra Pradesh received 960.3 mm of rainfall in 2024-25. By how much did this exceed normal?
ne6d07df3069.x: Rainfall in 2024-25 was 960.3 mm against a normal of 860.0 mm, an excess of 11.7%.

o: Crop and short-term loans with supply of farm inputs
n305c877e216.x: PACS provide crop and short-term loans and supply inputs such as fertilisers, pesticides, seeds and cattle feed.

n5d3492bfbd5.s: NABARD supports the transformation of PACS into:
n5d3492bfbd5.x: NABARD supports turning PACS into Multi-Service Centres.

ndf4f11b1658.s: The Kisan Credit Card, a NABARD model scheme based on the R.V. Gupta Committee, was introduced in:
ndf4f11b1658.x: The KCC was introduced in 1998 as a NABARD model scheme based on the R.V. Gupta Committee.

n5daa3d7e7f4.s: Andhra Bank, founded by Pattabhi Sitaramayya at Machilipatnam in 1923, was merged in 2020 into:
n5daa3d7e7f4.x: Andhra Bank merged into Union Bank of India on 1 April 2020.

nindian-economy-59-17.s: Which of the following about the Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF) is NOT correct?
nindian-economy-59-17.x: RIDF began in 1995–96 with an initial corpus of ₹2,000 crore, not ₹20,000 crore.

nindian-economy-59-19.s: Which of the following pairs (activity – RIDF category) is correctly matched?
o: Rural drinking water supply – Social sector
Rural roads – Agriculture and related sector
nindian-economy-59-19.x: Rural drinking water is under the social sector; rural roads fall under rural connectivity and minor irrigation under agriculture and related sectors.

nfc344f72b1d.s: Nationally, scheduled commercial banks provide about what share of formal farm credit?
nfc344f72b1d.x: Scheduled commercial banks provide over 70% of formal farm credit nationally.

n69d21873f68.s: Tenant, tribal, women and oral-lessee farmers in Andhra Pradesh are often excluded from formal credit mainly because they lack:
n69d21873f68.x: Formal lending generally requires land records, which many such farmers do not possess.

ne4f6542ede7.s: At the 20 April 2021 payout of the YSR Zero Interest Crop Loan scheme, rabi crop loans were covered up to:
ne4f6542ede7.x: The scheme covered rabi crop loans up to Rs 1 lakh for farmers who repaid on time, with the State bearing the interest.

n35027097ddc.s: Stree Nidhi in Andhra Pradesh is a:
o: Credit cooperative federation promoted with SHG federations
n35027097ddc.x: Stree Nidhi is a credit cooperative federation promoted with SHG federations.

n29ff08b7a02.s: Under the MEPMA self-employment programme, SHG bank linkage is permitted up to:
n29ff08b7a02.x: MEPMA permits SHG bank linkage up to Rs 20 lakh; individual loans range from Rs 50,000 to Rs 2 lakh and group loans up to Rs 10 lakh.

n48b3240a475.s: Which of the following was a feature of the Model APMC Act?
n48b3240a475.x: The Model APMC Act introduced a single market fee, registration in place of licensing, and farmers' and consumers' markets.

n89711f05fe2.s: In a Rythu Bazar, farmers sell their produce directly to:
n89711f05fe2.x: Farmers sell directly to consumers in Rythu Bazars, whereas in regulated market yards they sell to licensed traders.

n23b0a0a7b3c.s: In 2025-26, how many of Andhra Pradesh's 1,052 warehouse godowns were operational?
n23b0a0a7b3c.x: AP had 1,052 godowns (9.65 lakh MT); 643 were operational with 5.92 lakh MT capacity.

ncd8ac44491b.s: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund primarily supports:
o: Uniform MSP procurement of all crops
Farm-gate infrastructure at Rythu Bharosa Kendras
ncd8ac44491b.x: AIF funds farm-gate infrastructure at Rythu Bharosa Kendras and the conversion of PACS into multipurpose facility centres.

ncc187b000e2.s: Which of the following pairs (AP policy – period) is correctly matched?
ncc187b000e2.x: The MSME Policy and the Single Desk Policy both belong to 2015-20; the Industrial Development Policy listed is the 2020-23 edition and IDP (4.0) covers 2024-29.

n948e3f728b3.s: The revised core-industry index, covering nine industries, carries a weight of:
n948e3f728b3.x: The revised nine-industry core index has a 32.88% weight; the earlier eight-industry index had 40.27%.

n5e5f1c46ed3.s: AP's Electronics Manufacturing Policy (4.0) 2024-29 focuses on electronics clusters at Kopparthy, Tirupati and:
n5e5f1c46ed3.x: The electronics policies focus on ESDM and electronics manufacturing clusters at Kopparthy, Tirupati and Sri City.

ne652b282653.s: MSMEs account for about what share of India's exports?
ne652b282653.x: The cited national figures for MSMEs are about 30% of GDP, 46% of exports and 28 crore jobs.

n7bda648ba3a.s: How many clusters does the approved AP Cluster Development Programme for 2026-30 cover?
n7bda648ba3a.x: The AP CDP has a ₹200 crore outlay, covers 45 clusters with Common Facility Centres and funds up to 80% of project cost.

n37f6ef98642.s: APEDB opened APEX Korea, the State's first overseas investment facilitation centre, at:
n37f6ef98642.x: APEDB opened APEX Korea at Busan as the State's first overseas investment facilitation centre.

n7f39555a7dc.s: The Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, dedicated to the nation on 1 August 1992, was built with technical collaboration from:
n7f39555a7dc.x: The Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is a shore-based integrated steel plant built with Soviet (USSR) technical collaboration.

naa30d7afbe0.s: Which of the following pairs (craft – district) is correctly matched?
naa30d7afbe0.x: Etikoppaka lacquer toys belong to Anakapalli, Kondapalli toys to NTR and Mangalagiri handloom to Guntur.

nc5bb6dc8da7.s: The Employment Creation Subsidy for units with more than five employees is up to what share of FCI?
nc5bb6dc8da7.x: The subsidy is up to 10% of FCI for units with more than five employees (8–9% for five or fewer), paid over five years.

n2cbbf15233e.s: Under IDP (4.0), a Large project that has installed only 50% of its capacity gets an investment subsidy restricted to:
n2cbbf15233e.x: For a Large project with only 50% capacity installed, the subsidy is limited to 6%; otherwise the ceiling may be up to 12%.

n72867263aae.s: Under AP's statutory single-window framework, an application not decided within the service-level deadline is:
n72867263aae.x: The Act provides for deemed approval when a department misses the prescribed deadline.

nfcd9379dafb.s: Which body was empowered to allot up to 50 acres directly without Cabinet approval?
nfcd9379dafb.x: APIIC was empowered to allot up to 50 acres directly without Cabinet approval.

n3e384da6356.s: In June 2026, the AP Cabinet ratified 87 SIPB projects worth about:
n3e384da6356.x: In June 2026 the Cabinet ratified 87 SIPB proposals valued at about ₹34,000 crore.

n588a4b009a6.s: After bifurcation, the MSME profile of Andhra Pradesh shifted towards:
n588a4b009a6.x: The post-bifurcation MSME profile of AP shifted towards capital-intensive industries.

n7ee4de59623.s: The CII Partnership Summit 2025 at Visakhapatnam produced MoUs worth about:
n7ee4de59623.x: The summit led to 610 MoUs worth ₹13.25 lakh crore, with employment potential of over 16 lakh jobs.

nda2e546dfb9.s: GI-tagged Etikoppaka lacquer toys are made from which wood?
nda2e546dfb9.x: Etikoppaka lacquer toys have GI status and are made of Ankudu wood with natural dyes.
